title: PurchaseOrderAgentPlugin
description: Semantic Kernel plugin providing autonomous inventory low-stock detection and draft Purchase Order generation.

functions.name: GetLowStockAlertsAsync
functions.description: Scans the warehouse inventory catalog to identify all active items where current stock quantity is at or below the reorder threshold. Use when asked 'Which items are low in stock?', 'Check stock alerts', or 'Show reorder alerts'.

returns.description: JSON array of LowStockAlertDto records detailing low-stock SKUs, quantities, and suggested replenishment amounts.

functions.name: CreateDraftPurchaseOrderAsync
functions.description: Autonomously generates and saves a draft Purchase Order in the database to replenish inventory for specified low-stock SKUs or all items currently below reorder threshold. Use when asked 'Generate draft purchase orders to replenish our inventory' or 'Create PO for low stock items'.

targetSkus.description: Optional comma-separated list of specific SKUs to replenish. If empty or omitted, replenishes all active items currently below reorder threshold.

returns.description: JSON representation of DraftPurchaseOrderResultDto detailing the created PurchaseOrder, line items, and estimated costs.
